text.en: right angles, angles greater than/smaller than a right angle
text.zh: 直角，比直角大或比直角小的角

text.en: using notation such as ∠ABC and ∠a to name angles
text.zh: 用 ∠ABC、∠a 这样的记号给角命名

text.en: drawing an angle of given size

caption.en: Two straight lines that meet at a point make an angle. The point is the vertex; the two lines are the arms.
caption.zh: 两条直线相交于一点，就形成一个角。这个点叫顶点，两条线叫角的边。

caption.en: Turn one arm away from the other. The more it turns, the bigger the angle.
caption.zh: 让一条边转开。转得越多，角越大。

words.en: long arms, smaller turn · short arms, bigger turn
words.zh: 边长，转得少 · 边短，转得多

caption.en: These arms are long, but they have turned less. The length of the arms does not change the size of an angle.
caption.zh: 这两条边很长，可是转得少。边的长短不改变角的大小。

words.en: the arm further round shows the bigger angle
words.zh: 另一条边转得远的，角大

caption.en: To compare two angles, put one on top of the other: vertex on vertex, one arm along one arm. The other arm shows which is bigger.
caption.zh: 比两个角，就把一个叠到另一个上：顶点对顶点，一条边对一条边。另一条边露在外面的，那个角大。

keyFacts.en: An angle is made by two arms meeting at a vertex.
keyFacts.zh: 角由两条边和一个顶点组成。

keyFacts.en: The size of an angle is the amount of turn, not the length of the arms.
keyFacts.zh: 角的大小是转了多少，不看边有多长。

prompt.en: Which angle is bigger?
prompt.zh: 哪个角大？

guide.en: Look at how far one arm has turned from the other. The length of the arms does not matter.
guide.zh: 看一条边离另一条边转开了多少。边的长短不要紧。

hints.en: Picture the two angles on top of each other, vertex on vertex.
hints.zh: 想象把两个角叠起来，顶点对顶点。

hints.en: Which one has its arms opened wider?
hints.zh: 哪一个的两条边张得更开？

correct.en: Yes. B has turned more, so it is the bigger angle, even though its arms are short.
correct.zh: 对。B 转得多，所以角大，虽然它的边短。

fallback.en: Not yet. Compare how far the arms have turned apart.
fallback.zh: 还没对。比一比两条边张开了多少。

reveal.en: B is bigger: its arms are opened wider. A has long arms but a small turn.
reveal.zh: B 大：它的两条边张得更开。A 的边长，可是转得少。

say.en: These arms are longer, but they have turned less. Compare the turn, not the length of the arms.
say.zh: 这两条边长，可是转得少。比的是转了多少，不是边有多长。

prompt.en: Which angle is bigger?
prompt.zh: 哪个角大？

guide.en: Do not look at how far apart the ends of the arms are. Look at how far one arm has turned from the other.
guide.zh: 不要看两条边的末端隔得多远。要看一条边离另一条边转开了多少。

hints.en: Imagine putting one angle on top of the other.
hints.zh: 想象把一个角叠到另一个上。

hints.en: Which one is opened wider near its vertex?
hints.zh: 哪一个在顶点附近张得更开？

correct.en: Yes. B has turned further, so it is bigger. A's ends are far apart only because its arms are long.
correct.zh: 对。B 转得多，所以角大。A 的末端隔得远，只是因为它的边长。

fallback.en: Not yet. Compare the turn at the vertex, not the gap between the ends.
fallback.zh: 还没对。比顶点处转了多少，不比末端之间的距离。

reveal.en: B is bigger: it is opened wider at the vertex.
reveal.zh: B 大：它在顶点处张得更开。

say.en: The ends of these arms are far apart because the arms are long, but they have turned less. Compare the turn.
say.zh: 这两条边的末端隔得远，是因为边长，可是转得少。比的是转了多少。

prompt.en: Which angle is smaller?
prompt.zh: 哪个角小？

guide.en: Short arms do not make an angle small. Compare how far each angle has turned.
guide.zh: 边短不等于角小。比一比每个角转了多少。

hints.en: Picture the two angles with their vertices on top of each other.
hints.zh: 想象两个角的顶点叠在一起。

hints.en: The one that has turned less is smaller.
hints.zh: 转得少的那个角小。

correct.en: Yes. A has turned less, so it is the smaller angle, even with long arms.
correct.zh: 对。A 转得少，所以角小，虽然它的边很长。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the turn between the arms, not their length.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看两条边之间转了多少，不看边的长短。

reveal.en: A is smaller: its arms are closer together.
reveal.zh: A 小：它的两条边靠得更近。

say.en: These arms are short, but they have turned more. The length of the arms does not change the size of an angle.
say.zh: 这两条边短，可是转得多。边的长短不改变角的大小。

prompt.en: Ravi opened three pairs of scissors. Which pair is opened the most?
prompt.zh: Ravi 张开了三把剪刀。哪一把张得最开？

guide.en: Each pair of scissors makes an angle. The biggest turn is opened the most.
guide.zh: 每把剪刀张开都成一个角。转得最多的张得最开。

hints.en: Ignore how long the blades are.
hints.zh: 不用管刀片有多长。

hints.en: Look at the turn at each vertex.
hints.zh: 看每个顶点处转了多少。

correct.en: Yes. B has the biggest turn between its arms.
correct.zh: 对。B 两条边之间转得最多。

fallback.en: Not yet. Compare the turns, not the lengths.
fallback.zh: 还没对。比转了多少，不比长短。

reveal.en: B is opened the most. A has the longest blades but the smallest turn.
reveal.zh: B 张得最开。A 的刀片最长，可是转得最少。

say.en: These arms are longer, but they have turned less. Compare the turn, not the length of the arms.
say.zh: 这两条边长，可是转得少。比的是转了多少，不是边有多长。

prompt.en: These angles show doors seen from above. Which door is open the most?
prompt.zh: 这些角是从上面看到的门。哪扇门开得最大？

guide.en: A door turns on its hinge, the vertex. The more it turns, the bigger the angle.
guide.zh: 门绕着门轴转，门轴就是顶点。转得越多，角越大。

hints.en: The drawings are turned different ways; that does not matter.
hints.zh: 这些图朝向不一样，这不要紧。

hints.en: Compare how far each door has turned.
hints.zh: 比一比每扇门转了多少。

correct.en: Yes. B has turned the most.
correct.zh: 对。B 转得最多。

fallback.en: Not yet. Compare the turn at each hinge.
fallback.zh: 还没对。比一比每个门轴处转了多少。

reveal.en: B is open the most. A has long arms but a smaller turn.
reveal.zh: B 开得最大。A 的边长，可是转得少。

say.en: These arms are longer, but they have turned less. Compare the turn, not the length of the arms.
say.zh: 这两条边长，可是转得少。比的是转了多少，不是边有多长。

prompt.en: How many angles does this shape have?
prompt.zh: 这个图形有几个角？

guide.en: An angle is made wherever two sides of the shape meet.
guide.zh: 图形的两条边在哪里相交，哪里就有一个角。

hints.en: Count the corners.
hints.zh: 数一数有几个尖角。

hints.en: Each corner is one angle.
hints.zh: 每个尖角是一个角。

correct.en: Yes. The shape has 3 corners, so it has 3 angles.
correct.zh: 对。这个图形有 3 个尖角，所以有 3 个角。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count each place where two sides meet.
fallback.zh: 还没对。数一数两条边相交的地方。

reveal.en: A triangle has 3 corners: 3 angles.
reveal.zh: 三角形有 3 个尖角：3 个角。

prompt.en: How many angles does this shape have?
prompt.zh: 这个图形有几个角？

guide.en: Two sides meet at each corner and make an angle.
guide.zh: 每个尖角处有两条边相交，形成一个角。

hints.en: Go round the shape and count the corners.
hints.zh: 沿着图形走一圈，数尖角。

hints.en: Start at the bottom left and touch each corner once.
hints.zh: 从左下角开始，每个尖角数一次。

correct.en: Yes. There are 5 corners, so there are 5 angles.
correct.zh: 对。有 5 个尖角，所以有 5 个角。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count the corners one by one as you go round.
fallback.zh: 还没对。沿着图形一个一个数尖角。

reveal.en: The shape has 5 corners: 5 angles.
reveal.zh: 这个图形有 5 个尖角：5 个角。

prompt.en: Which of these make an angle? Choose all that do.
prompt.zh: 哪些形成了角？把是的都选上。

guide.en: An angle needs two straight lines that meet at a point.
guide.zh: 角要有两条直线相交于一点。

hints.en: Check whether the two lines touch.
hints.zh: 看两条线有没有碰到。

hints.en: Two lines that never meet do not make an angle.
hints.zh: 不相交的两条线不形成角。

correct.en: Yes. A and C each have two lines meeting at a point.
correct.zh: 对。A 和 C 都是两条线相交于一点。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for two lines that meet at one point.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找两条线相交于一点的。

reveal.en: A and C make angles. In B the two lines do not meet.
reveal.zh: A 和 C 形成了角。B 里的两条线没有相交。

prompt.en: Which of these make an angle? Choose all that do.
prompt.zh: 哪些形成了角？把是的都选上。

guide.en: Look for two straight lines that meet at one point, the vertex.
guide.zh: 找两条直线相交于一点的，这个点就是顶点。

hints.en: Lines that run side by side never meet.
hints.zh: 并排走的两条线永远不相交。

hints.en: Two of them have a vertex.
hints.zh: 其中两个有顶点。

correct.en: Yes. A and B have two lines meeting at a point.
correct.zh: 对。A 和 B 都有两条线相交于一点。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find where two lines meet.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找两条线相交的地方。

reveal.en: A and B make angles. The lines in C never meet.
reveal.zh: A 和 B 形成了角。C 里的线永远不相交。

caption.en: A square corner, like the corner of a page, is a right angle. We mark it with a small square.
caption.zh: 方方正正的角，像书页的角，叫直角。直角用一个小方块标出来。

words.zh: 四分之一圈 = 1 个直角

caption.en: At 3 o'clock the two hands make a right angle. The minute hand turns through a right angle in 15 minutes: a quarter of a full turn.
caption.zh: 3 点整，两根针成一个直角。分针 15 分钟转过一个直角，是一整圈的四分之一。

caption.en: Fold a sheet of paper in half, then in half again. The folded corner is a right angle you can carry: a right-angle tester.
caption.zh: 把一张纸对折，再对折。折出来的角就是一个随身的直角，叫直角板。

caption.en: Turned round, it is still a right angle. Put the tester in the corner: both arms lie along its edges.
caption.zh: 斜着放，它还是直角。把直角板放进去，两条边都贴着直角板的边。

keyFacts.en: A right angle is a square corner, a quarter turn.
keyFacts.zh: 直角是方方正正的角，是四分之一圈。

keyFacts.en: A right angle stays a right angle however it is turned.
keyFacts.zh: 不管怎么转，直角还是直角。

prompt.en: Which of these are right angles? Choose all that are.
prompt.zh: 哪些是直角？把是直角的都选上。

guide.en: A right angle is a square corner, however it is turned. Use a tester in your head.
guide.zh: 直角是方方正正的角，不管怎么放。在脑子里用直角板比一比。

hints.en: Turn the page in your head so one arm lies flat.
hints.zh: 在脑子里把纸转一转，让一条边放平。

hints.en: Two of them are square corners; one of those is tilted.
hints.zh: 有两个是方方正正的角，其中一个是斜着放的。

correct.en: Yes. A and B are both right angles; A is just turned.
correct.zh: 对。A 和 B 都是直角，A 只是斜着放。

fallback.en: Not yet. Put a right-angle tester in each corner: both arms must lie along its edges.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把直角板放进每个角：两条边都要贴着直角板的边。

reveal.en: A and B are right angles. C is a little smaller and D a little greater than a right angle.
reveal.zh: A 和 B 是直角。C 比直角小一点，D 比直角大一点。

say.en: Turn the page in your head: the tilted corner is still square. Put the right-angle tester in it.
say.zh: 在脑子里把纸转一转，斜着的这个角还是方方正正的。用直角板去比一比。

prompt.en: Which of these are right angles? Choose all that are.
prompt.zh: 哪些是直角？把是的都选上。

guide.en: A right angle is a square corner, whichever way it is turned.
guide.zh: 直角是方方正正的角，不管朝哪个方向。

hints.en: Imagine turning each angle until one arm lies flat.
hints.zh: 想象把每个角转一转，让一条边放平。

hints.en: Two are square corners.
hints.zh: 有两个是方方正正的角。

correct.en: Yes. A and B are right angles; A is tilted.
correct.zh: 对。A 和 B 是直角，A 是斜着放的。

fallback.en: Not yet. Put a tester in each corner in your head.
fallback.zh: 还没对。在脑子里把直角板放进每个角。

reveal.en: A and B are right angles. C is greater and D is smaller than a right angle.
reveal.zh: A 和 B 是直角。C 比直角大，D 比直角小。

say.en: Turn the page in your head: the corner is still square. Put the right-angle tester in it.
say.zh: 在脑子里把纸转一转，这个角还是方方正正的。用直角板去比一比。

prompt.en: Which of these are right angles? Choose all that are.
prompt.zh: 哪些是直角？把是的都选上。

guide.en: Check each corner with a right-angle tester in your head.
guide.zh: 在脑子里用直角板比一比每个角。

hints.en: A tilted corner can still be square.
hints.zh: 斜着的角也可能是方方正正的。

hints.en: Two of them are right angles.
hints.zh: 其中两个是直角。

correct.en: Yes. A and B are right angles; A is turned round.
correct.zh: 对。A 和 B 是直角，A 是转过来放的。

fallback.en: Not yet. Both arms must lie along the tester's edges.
fallback.zh: 还没对。两条边都要贴着直角板的边。

reveal.en: A and B are right angles. C is smaller and D is greater than a right angle.
reveal.zh: A 和 B 是直角。C 比直角小，D 比直角大。

say.en: Turn the page in your head: the corner is still square. Put the right-angle tester in it.
say.zh: 在脑子里把纸转一转，这个角还是方方正正的。用直角板去比一比。

prompt.en: Which one is a right angle?
prompt.zh: 哪一个是直角？

guide.en: Some angles are only a little bigger or smaller than a right angle. Check each one carefully.
guide.zh: 有的角只比直角大一点或小一点。每个都仔细比一比。

hints.en: Picture the tester in each corner.
hints.zh: 想象把直角板放进每个角。

hints.en: The square corner is tilted.
hints.zh: 那个方方正正的角是斜着放的。

correct.en: Yes. C is a square corner, turned a little.
correct.zh: 对。C 是方方正正的角，只是转了一点。

fallback.en: Not yet. A right angle fits the tester exactly.
fallback.zh: 还没对。直角正好和直角板贴合。

reveal.en: C is the right angle. A is a little smaller, B a little greater.
reveal.zh: C 是直角。A 小一点，B 大一点。

prompt.en: How many right angles does this rectangle have?
prompt.zh: 这个长方形有几个直角？

guide.en: Check each corner of the rectangle with a right-angle tester.
guide.zh: 用直角板比一比长方形的每个角。

hints.en: A rectangle has 4 corners.
hints.zh: 长方形有 4 个角。

hints.en: Is every corner square?
hints.zh: 每个角都是方方正正的吗？

correct.en: Yes. All 4 corners of a rectangle are right angles.
correct.zh: 对。长方形的 4 个角都是直角。

fallback.en: Not yet. Test every corner, one by one.
fallback.zh: 还没对。一个角一个角地比。

reveal.en: A rectangle has 4 right angles.

prompt.en: How many right angles does this shape have?
prompt.zh: 这个图形有几个直角？

guide.en: Test each corner. Only the square ones count.
guide.zh: 比一比每个角，只数方方正正的。

hints.en: Look at the corners on the left.
hints.zh: 看左边的两个角。

hints.en: The two corners on the right are not square.
hints.zh: 右边两个角不是方方正正的。

correct.en: Yes. The two corners on the left are right angles.
correct.zh: 对。左边两个角是直角。

fallback.en: Not yet. Put the tester in each of the 4 corners.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把直角板放进 4 个角里比一比。

reveal.en: The shape has 2 right angles, both on the left. The other two are not square.
reveal.zh: 这个图形有 2 个直角，都在左边。另外两个不是方方正正的。

prompt.en: Wei Jie drew a house shape. How many right angles does it have?
prompt.zh: Wei Jie 画了一个小屋形状。它有几个直角？

guide.en: Check all 5 corners. The roof corners are not square.
guide.zh: 比一比 5 个角。屋顶的角不是方方正正的。

hints.en: Look at the corners at the bottom.
hints.zh: 看底下的两个角。

hints.en: Only the 2 bottom corners are square.
hints.zh: 只有底下 2 个角是方方正正的。

correct.en: Yes. The 2 bottom corners are right angles; the 3 roof corners are not.
correct.zh: 对。底下 2 个角是直角，屋顶的 3 个角不是。

fallback.en: Not yet. Test each corner, including the roof.
fallback.zh: 还没对。每个角都比一比，包括屋顶。

reveal.en: The house has 2 right angles, at the bottom.
reveal.zh: 小屋有 2 个直角，在底下。

prompt.en: How many right angles does this tilted square have?
prompt.zh: 这个斜放的正方形有几个直角？

guide.en: Turning a square does not change its corners.
guide.zh: 把正方形转一转，它的角不会变。

hints.en: Turn the page in your head until a side lies flat.
hints.zh: 在脑子里把纸转一转，让一条边放平。

hints.en: Every corner of a square is square.
hints.zh: 正方形的每个角都是方方正正的。

correct.en: Yes. All 4 corners are still right angles, even turned.
correct.zh: 对。转过来以后，4 个角还是直角。

fallback.en: Not yet. Picture the square turned back so it sits flat.
fallback.zh: 还没对。想象把正方形转回去放平。

reveal.en: A square has 4 right angles, however it is turned.
reveal.zh: 正方形有 4 个直角，不管怎么放。

prompt.en: On which clocks do the hands make a right angle? Choose all.
prompt.zh: 哪些钟面上，两根针成直角？都选上。

guide.en: The hands make a right angle when the minute hand is a quarter turn away from the hour hand.
guide.zh: 分针离时针正好四分之一圈时，两根针成直角。

hints.en: A quarter turn is 3 numbers on the clock.
hints.zh: 四分之一圈是钟面上的 3 个数。

hints.en: Look closely at 12.15: where is the hour hand?
hints.zh: 仔细看 12.15：时针在哪里？

correct.en: Yes. At 3 o'clock and 9 o'clock the hands make right angles.
correct.zh: 对。3 点和 9 点时，两根针成直角。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check each clock: is the minute hand a quarter turn from the hour hand?
fallback.zh: 还没对。看每个钟：分针离时针是不是四分之一圈？

reveal.en: A (3 o'clock) and B (9 o'clock). At 6 o'clock the hands make a straight line. At 12.15 the hour hand has moved a little past 12, so the angle is a little smaller than a right angle.
reveal.zh: A（3 点）和 B（9 点）。6 点时两根针成一条直线。12.15 时时针已经走过 12 一点，所以这个角比直角小一点。

caption.en: Put the tester on the angle, one edge along an arm. The other arm lies inside the tester, so this angle is smaller than a right angle.
caption.zh: 把直角板放上去，一条边对齐。另一条边在直角板里面，所以这个角比直角小。

caption.en: Now the other arm lies outside the tester. This angle is greater than a right angle.
caption.zh: 这次另一条边在直角板外面。这个角比直角大。

words.zh: 2 个比直角小 · 1 个直角 · 2 个比直角大

caption.en: Sort these angles with the tester. The long arms on the first one do not make it bigger: it is still smaller than a right angle.
caption.zh: 用直角板把这几个角分一分。第一个角的边很长，可它还是比直角小。

caption.en: A shape can have all three kinds of angle. This triangle has one angle greater than a right angle and two smaller ones.
caption.zh: 一个图形里，三种角都可能有。这个三角形有一个角比直角大，两个比直角小。

keyFacts.en: Inside the tester: smaller than a right angle. Outside: greater.
keyFacts.zh: 在直角板里面，比直角小；在外面，比直角大。

keyFacts.en: Long arms do not make an angle bigger.
keyFacts.zh: 边长不会让角变大。

prompt.en: The tester is on the angle. What kind of angle is it?
prompt.zh: 直角板放在角上了。这是哪一种角？

guide.en: One edge of the tester lies along an arm. Look where the other arm is: inside the tester or outside it.
guide.zh: 直角板的一条边贴着一条边。看另一条边在哪里：在直角板里面，还是外面。

hints.en: Find the arm that is not along the tester.
hints.zh: 找到没贴着直角板的那条边。

hints.en: It is outside the tester's corner.
hints.zh: 它在直角板的角外面。

correct.en: Yes. The other arm is outside the tester, so the angle is greater than a right angle.
correct.zh: 对。另一条边在直角板外面，所以这个角比直角大。

fallback.en: Not yet. Is the other arm inside the tester, along its edge, or outside?
fallback.zh: 还没对。另一条边在直角板里面、贴着它的边，还是在外面？

reveal.en: The other arm is outside the tester: greater than a right angle.
reveal.zh: 另一条边在直角板外面：比直角大。

say.en: The arms look short, but size is the turn. The other arm is outside the tester.
say.zh: 两条边看起来短，可是角的大小看转了多少。另一条边在直角板外面。

prompt.en: The tester is on the angle. What kind of angle is it?
prompt.zh: 直角板放在角上了。这是哪一种角？

guide.en: Long arms do not change the angle. Look where the other arm lies: inside or outside the tester.
guide.zh: 边长不改变角。看另一条边在哪里：在直角板里面还是外面。

hints.en: Find the arm that is not along the tester's edge.
hints.zh: 找到没贴着直角板边的那条边。

hints.en: It lies inside the tester.
hints.zh: 它在直角板里面。

correct.en: Yes. The other arm is inside the tester, so it is smaller than a right angle.
correct.zh: 对。另一条边在直角板里面，所以比直角小。

fallback.en: Not yet. Ignore how long the arms are and look at the tester.
fallback.zh: 还没对。不管边多长，看直角板。

reveal.en: Smaller than a right angle: the other arm lies inside the tester.
reveal.zh: 比直角小：另一条边在直角板里面。

say.en: These arms are long, but they have turned less than the tester. Compare the turn, not the length.
say.zh: 这两条边很长，可是比直角板转得少。比的是转了多少，不是长短。

prompt.en: The tester is on this tilted angle. What kind of angle is it?
prompt.zh: 直角板放在这个斜着的角上。这是哪一种角？

guide.en: The tester is tilted too. Check whether the other arm lies inside, along or outside its edge.
guide.zh: 直角板也斜着放。看另一条边在它的边里面、正好贴着，还是在外面。

hints.en: Look at the arm that is not along the first edge.
hints.zh: 看不在第一条边上的那条边。

hints.en: It lies exactly along the tester's other edge.
hints.zh: 它正好贴着直角板的另一条边。

correct.en: Yes. Both arms lie along the tester's edges: it is a right angle, just tilted.
correct.zh: 对。两条边都贴着直角板的边：这是直角，只是斜着放。

fallback.en: Not yet. Turn the page in your head and look again.
fallback.zh: 还没对。在脑子里把纸转一转，再看一看。

reveal.en: A right angle: both arms fit the tester exactly.
reveal.zh: 直角：两条边正好贴着直角板。

say.en: Turn the page in your head: the corner is still square. Put the right-angle tester in it.
say.zh: 在脑子里把纸转一转，这个角还是方方正正的。用直角板去比一比。

prompt.en: Which of these are greater than a right angle? Choose all that are.
prompt.zh: 哪些比直角大？把是的都选上。

guide.en: Compare each angle with a right angle. Do not go by the length of the arms.
guide.zh: 把每个角和直角比一比。不要看边的长短。

hints.en: Picture the tester in each angle.
hints.zh: 想象把直角板放进每个角。

hints.en: Two of them have their other arm outside the tester.
hints.zh: 有两个角的另一条边在直角板外面。

correct.en: Yes. A and B are both greater than a right angle.
correct.zh: 对。A 和 B 都比直角大。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check each one with the tester in your head.
fallback.zh: 还没对。在脑子里用直角板一个一个比。

reveal.en: A and B are greater than a right angle. C is smaller, even with long arms; D is a right angle.
reveal.zh: A 和 B 比直角大。C 边长，可是比直角小；D 是直角。

say.en: These arms are longer, but they have turned less. Compare the turn, not the length of the arms.
say.zh: 这两条边长，可是转得少。比的是转了多少，不是边有多长。

prompt.en: Which of these are smaller than a right angle? Choose all that are.
prompt.zh: 哪些比直角小？把是的都选上。

guide.en: Turn each angle in your head and put the tester on it.
guide.zh: 在脑子里把每个角转一转，用直角板比一比。

hints.en: A tilted angle can still be smaller than a right angle, or equal to one.
hints.zh: 斜着的角也可能比直角小，或者正好是直角。

hints.en: Two of them are smaller.
hints.zh: 其中两个比直角小。

correct.en: Yes. A and B are smaller than a right angle.
correct.zh: 对。A 和 B 比直角小。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check each angle with the tester, whichever way it points.
fallback.zh: 还没对。不管朝哪个方向，都用直角板比一比。

reveal.en: A and B are smaller. C is a right angle, and so is D: it is only tilted.
reveal.zh: A 和 B 比直角小。C 是直角，D 也是直角，只是斜着放。

say.en: This tilted corner is square: turn the page in your head and put the tester in it. It is a right angle, not smaller.
say.zh: 这个斜着的角是方方正正的：在脑子里把纸转一转，用直角板比一比。它是直角，不比直角小。

prompt.en: Siti opened her scissors this far. What kind of angle do the blades make?
prompt.zh: Siti 把剪刀张开到这么大。两片刀片成哪一种角？

guide.en: The tester sits on one blade. Is the other blade inside it, along it or outside it?
guide.zh: 直角板贴着一片刀片。另一片在它里面、贴着它，还是在外面？

hints.en: Look at the second blade.
hints.zh: 看第二片刀片。

hints.en: It has not reached the tester's other edge.
hints.zh: 它还没到直角板的另一条边。

correct.en: Yes. The second blade is inside the tester: smaller than a right angle.
correct.zh: 对。第二片刀片在直角板里面：比直角小。

fallback.en: Not yet. Compare the second blade with the tester's other edge.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把第二片刀片和直角板的另一条边比一比。

reveal.en: Smaller than a right angle: the blade lies inside the tester.
reveal.zh: 比直角小：刀片在直角板里面。

prompt.en: What kind of angle is ∠a in this triangle?
prompt.zh: 三角形里的 ∠a 是哪一种角？

guide.en: Put the tester in the corner marked a, one edge along the bottom side.
guide.zh: 把直角板放进标着 a 的角，一条边贴着底边。

hints.en: Look where the other side goes.
hints.zh: 看另一条边往哪里走。

hints.en: It stays inside the tester.
hints.zh: 它在直角板里面。

correct.en: Yes. ∠a is smaller than a right angle.
correct.zh: 对。∠a 比直角小。

fallback.en: Not yet. Use the tester on the corner marked a.
fallback.zh: 还没对。用直角板比一比标着 a 的角。

reveal.en: ∠a is smaller than a right angle.

prompt.en: What kind of angle is ∠b in this shape?
prompt.zh: 这个图形里的 ∠b 是哪一种角？

guide.en: Check the corner marked b with the tester.
guide.zh: 用直角板比一比标着 b 的角。

hints.en: One edge of the tester along the bottom side.
hints.zh: 直角板的一条边贴着底边。

hints.en: The slanting side goes outside the tester.
hints.zh: 斜边在直角板外面。

correct.en: Yes. ∠b is greater than a right angle.
correct.zh: 对。∠b 比直角大。

fallback.en: Not yet. Put the tester in the corner marked b.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把直角板放进标着 b 的角。

reveal.en: ∠b is greater than a right angle.

prompt.en: What kind of angle is ∠c in this shape?
prompt.zh: 这个图形里的 ∠c 是哪一种角？

guide.en: Check the corner marked c with the tester.
guide.zh: 用直角板比一比标着 c 的角。

hints.en: Both sides of that corner run along the paper's edges.
hints.zh: 这个角的两条边分别是横的和竖的。

hints.en: They fit the tester exactly.
hints.zh: 它们正好贴着直角板。

correct.en: Yes. ∠c is a right angle: both sides fit the tester.
correct.zh: 对。∠c 是直角：两条边都贴着直角板。

fallback.en: Not yet. Put the tester in the corner marked c.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把直角板放进标着 c 的角。

reveal.en: ∠c is a right angle.

caption.en: Two straight lines that meet at a right angle are perpendicular. Line AB is perpendicular to line CD.
caption.zh: 两条直线相交成直角，就说它们互相垂直。直线 AB 垂直于直线 CD。

words.zh: 相隔 3 格 · 相隔 3 格

caption.en: Parallel lines go the same way and stay the same distance apart. However far they go, they never meet.
caption.zh: 平行线方向一样，之间的距离处处相等。不管延长多远，都不会相交。

caption.en: Tilted lines can be perpendicular too. These two lines do not meet on the page, but they come closer, 3 squares apart, then 2: they are not parallel.
caption.zh: 斜着的两条线也能垂直。右边这两条线在纸上没有相交，可是越来越近，先隔 3 格，再隔 2 格：它们不平行。

words.en: parallel: 3 right, 1 up · perpendicular: 1 right, 3 down
words.zh: 平行：向右 3、向上 1 · 垂直：向右 1、向下 3

caption.en: To draw a parallel line on dot paper, copy the steps: AB goes 3 right and 1 up, so the new line does too. A perpendicular line goes 1 right and 3 down.
caption.zh: 在点阵上画平行线，就照着走法画：AB 向右 3 格、向上 1 格，新线也一样。垂线则是向右 1 格、向下 3 格。

keyFacts.en: Perpendicular lines meet at a right angle.
keyFacts.zh: 互相垂直的两条线相交成直角。

keyFacts.en: Parallel lines are always the same distance apart and never meet.
keyFacts.zh: 平行线之间的距离处处相等，永远不相交。

keyFacts.en: On dot paper, copy the steps of a line to draw a line parallel to it.
keyFacts.zh: 在点阵上照着一条线的走法画，就得到它的平行线。

prompt.en: Draw a line from P that is parallel to AB. Tap the dot where it ends.
prompt.zh: 从 P 画一条和 AB 平行的线。点一下线的另一端。

guide.en: Count how AB goes: how many dots right, how many up. A parallel line goes the same way.
guide.zh: 数一数 AB 怎么走：向右几格、向上几格。平行线也照这样走。

hints.en: AB goes 3 dots right.
hints.zh: AB 向右走 3 格。

hints.en: It goes 3 right and 1 up. Do the same from P.
hints.zh: 它向右 3 格、向上 1 格。从 P 也这样走。

correct.en: Yes. Your line goes 3 right and 1 up, just like AB, so they stay the same distance apart.
correct.zh: 对。你的线向右 3 格、向上 1 格，和 AB 一样，所以两条线的距离处处相等。

fallback.en: Not yet. Copy the steps of AB: count the dots right, then up.
fallback.zh: 还没对。照着 AB 的走法画：先数向右几格，再数向上几格。

reveal.en: From P go 3 right and 1 up: the line is parallel to AB.
reveal.zh: 从 P 向右 3 格、向上 1 格：这条线和 AB 平行。

say.en: These lines come closer as they go: your line goes up 2, AB only 1. Parallel lines stay the same distance apart.
say.zh: 这两条线越走越近：你的线向上 2 格，AB 只向上 1 格。平行线之间的距离处处一样。

prompt.en: Draw a line from P that is parallel to AB. Tap the dot where it ends.
prompt.zh: 从 P 画一条和 AB 平行的线。点一下线的另一端。

guide.en: AB goes straight across. A line parallel to it goes straight across too and keeps the same gap.
guide.zh: AB 是横着走的。和它平行的线也横着走，间距不变。

hints.en: AB goes 4 dots right and does not go up.
hints.zh: AB 向右走 4 格，不向上走。

hints.en: From P go right along the same row.
hints.zh: 从 P 沿着同一行向右走。

correct.en: Yes. Your line goes straight across like AB, so the gap stays 3 squares.
correct.zh: 对。你的线和 AB 一样横着走，所以间距一直是 3 格。

fallback.en: Not yet. Stay on P's row of dots.
fallback.zh: 还没对。要在 P 所在的那一行点上走。

reveal.en: From P go 4 dots right on the same row: the line is parallel to AB.
reveal.zh: 从 P 在同一行向右走 4 格：这条线和 AB 平行。

say.en: Your line climbs 1 square, but AB stays level. The gap changes from 3 to 4: they are not parallel.
say.zh: 你的线向上走了 1 格，可是 AB 是平的。间距从 3 格变成 4 格：它们不平行。

prompt.en: Draw a line from P that is perpendicular to AB. Tap the dot where it ends.
prompt.zh: 从 P 画一条和 AB 垂直的线。点一下线的另一端。

guide.en: Perpendicular lines meet at a right angle. AB goes across, so the new line goes straight up or down.
guide.zh: 互相垂直的线相交成直角。AB 是横的，所以新线要竖直向上或向下。

hints.en: Which way makes a square corner with AB?
hints.zh: 朝哪个方向走，才能和 AB 成方方正正的角？

hints.en: Go straight up from P, at least 2 dots.
hints.zh: 从 P 竖直向上走，至少 2 格。

correct.en: Yes. Your line goes straight up from AB and makes a right angle with it.
correct.zh: 对。你的线从 AB 竖直向上，和它成直角。

fallback.en: Not yet. The line must make a square corner with AB.
fallback.zh: 还没对。这条线要和 AB 成方方正正的角。

reveal.en: From P go straight up (or down): the line is perpendicular to AB.
reveal.zh: 从 P 竖直向上（或向下）：这条线和 AB 垂直。

prompt.en: Draw a line from P that is perpendicular to AB. Tap the dot where it ends.
prompt.zh: 从 P 画一条和 AB 垂直的线。点一下线的另一端。

guide.en: AB goes 3 right and 1 up. A line perpendicular to it swaps the steps: 1 across and 3 up.
guide.zh: AB 向右 3 格、向上 1 格。和它垂直的线把走法换过来：横走 1 格、竖走 3 格。

hints.en: Count AB's steps: right, then up.
hints.zh: 数一数 AB 的走法：向右几格，向上几格。

hints.en: From P go 1 left and 3 up.
hints.zh: 从 P 向左 1 格、向上 3 格。

correct.en: Yes. 1 left and 3 up makes a right angle with 3 right and 1 up.
correct.zh: 对。向左 1、向上 3，和向右 3、向上 1 成直角。

fallback.en: Not yet. Swap AB's steps: 1 across, 3 up, and go back the other way.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把 AB 的走法换过来：横走 1 格、竖走 3 格，方向反过来。

reveal.en: From P go 1 left and 3 up: the line is perpendicular to AB.
reveal.zh: 从 P 向左 1 格、向上 3 格：这条线和 AB 垂直。

prompt.en: Which line is parallel to AB?
prompt.zh: 哪条线和 AB 平行？

guide.en: Parallel lines stay the same distance apart all the way along. Count the gap at both ends.
guide.zh: 平行线之间的距离处处一样。数一数两头的间距。

hints.en: Count the squares from AB to each line at the left end, then the right end.
hints.zh: 数一数每条线到 AB 的距离：左端几格，右端几格。

hints.en: One gap changes from 2 to 3.
hints.zh: 有一条的间距从 2 格变成 3 格。

correct.en: Yes. EF is 5 squares from AB at both ends.
correct.zh: 对。EF 两头离 AB 都是 5 格。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check the gap at both ends of each line.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看每条线两头的间距。

reveal.en: EF is parallel to AB. CD is 2 squares from AB at one end and 3 at the other.
reveal.zh: EF 和 AB 平行。CD 一头离 AB 2 格，另一头 3 格。

say.en: CD comes away from AB: 2 squares at one end, 3 at the other. Parallel lines stay the same distance apart.
say.zh: CD 离 AB 越来越远：一头 2 格，另一头 3 格。平行线之间的距离处处一样。

prompt.en: Are AB and CD perpendicular?
prompt.zh: AB 和 CD 互相垂直吗？

guide.en: Perpendicular lines meet at a right angle, even when they are tilted.
guide.zh: 互相垂直的线相交成直角，斜着的也一样。

hints.en: Find where they cross and check the corner with a tester in your head.
hints.zh: 找到它们的交点，在脑子里用直角板比一比那个角。

hints.en: AB goes 1 right, 2 up; CD goes 2 right, 1 down.
hints.zh: AB 向右 1、向上 2；CD 向右 2、向下 1。

correct.en: Yes. They cross at a square corner, so they are perpendicular even though both are tilted.
correct.zh: 对。它们相交成方方正正的角，所以互相垂直，虽然两条线都是斜的。

fallback.en: Not yet. Turn the page in your head and test the corner where they cross.
fallback.zh: 还没对。在脑子里把纸转一转，比一比交点处的角。

reveal.en: Yes, they are perpendicular: the corner where they cross is a right angle.
reveal.zh: 是，它们互相垂直：交点处的角是直角。

say.en: Turn the page in your head: the corner is still square. Put the right-angle tester in it.
say.zh: 在脑子里把纸转一转，这个角还是方方正正的。用直角板去比一比。

prompt.en: AB and CD do not meet on the page. Are they parallel?
prompt.zh: AB 和 CD 在纸上没有相交。它们平行吗？

guide.en: Not meeting on the page is not enough. Parallel lines stay the same distance apart everywhere.
guide.zh: 在纸上不相交还不够。平行线之间的距离处处一样。

hints.en: Count the gap at the left end and at the right end.
hints.zh: 数一数左端和右端的间距。

hints.en: The gap goes from 3 squares to 2.
hints.zh: 间距从 3 格变成 2 格。

correct.en: Yes. They come closer, 3 squares apart then 2, so they are not parallel; further on they would meet.
correct.zh: 对。它们越来越近，先隔 3 格，再隔 2 格，所以不平行；再往前延长就会相交。

fallback.en: Not yet. Compare the gap at both ends.
fallback.zh: 还没对。比一比两头的间距。

reveal.en: No: the gap is 3 squares at one end and 2 at the other.
reveal.zh: 不平行：一头隔 3 格，另一头隔 2 格。

say.en: These lines come closer as they go: 3 squares apart, then 2. Parallel lines stay the same distance apart.
say.zh: 这两条线越走越近：先隔 3 格，再隔 2 格。平行线之间的距离处处一样。

prompt.en: Aisha's window grille has bars like this. Which bar is parallel to bar AB?
prompt.zh: Aisha 家的窗花是这样的。哪根杆和 AB 平行？

guide.en: Parallel bars go the same way and never meet. Perpendicular bars cross at a right angle.
guide.zh: 平行的杆方向一样，永远不相交。垂直的杆相交成直角。

hints.en: AB stands upright.
hints.zh: AB 是竖着的。

hints.en: Find the other upright bar that is labelled.
hints.zh: 找另一根标了字母的竖杆。

correct.en: Yes. EF stands upright like AB and stays the same distance from it.
correct.zh: 对。EF 和 AB 一样是竖的，两根之间的距离处处一样。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look for a bar that goes the same way as AB.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找和 AB 方向一样的杆。

reveal.en: EF is parallel to AB. CD crosses AB at a right angle: it is perpendicular to AB.
reveal.zh: EF 和 AB 平行。CD 和 AB 相交成直角：它和 AB 垂直。

prompt.en: In the same window grille, which bar is perpendicular to bar AB?
prompt.zh: 还是这个窗花，哪根杆和 AB 垂直？

guide.en: Perpendicular bars cross at a right angle.
guide.zh: 互相垂直的杆相交成直角。

hints.en: Which labelled bar crosses AB?
hints.zh: 哪根标了字母的杆和 AB 相交？

hints.en: The crossbar goes straight across.
hints.zh: 横杆是横着的。

correct.en: Yes. CD crosses AB at a right angle.
correct.zh: 对。CD 和 AB 相交成直角。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the bar that crosses AB and check the corner.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找和 AB 相交的杆，比一比那个角。

reveal.en: CD is perpendicular to AB. EF never meets AB: it is parallel to it.
reveal.zh: CD 和 AB 垂直。EF 永远不和 AB 相交：它和 AB 平行。

caption.en: Points on the arms are named with capital letters. This angle is ∠ABC, said "angle ABC". The vertex letter, B, goes in the middle.
caption.zh: 边上的点用大写字母表示。这个角写作 ∠ABC，读作“角 ABC”。顶点 B 写在中间。

caption.en: ∠CBA names the same angle: start on one arm, go through the vertex, end on the other arm.
caption.zh: ∠CBA 说的是同一个角：从一条边上的点出发，经过顶点，到另一条边上的点。

caption.en: Three angles meet at B here, so "∠B" alone is not clear. Three letters, with B in the middle, say which one you mean.
caption.zh: 这里有三个角都以 B 为顶点，只写“∠B”说不清是哪一个。写三个字母、B 在中间，才说得清。

caption.en: An angle can also be named with a small letter written inside it, like ∠a.
caption.zh: 也可以在角里写一个小写字母，叫它 ∠a。

keyFacts.en: ∠ABC: the vertex letter goes in the middle.
keyFacts.zh: ∠ABC：顶点字母在中间。

keyFacts.en: ∠a: a small letter inside the angle.
keyFacts.zh: ∠a：角里写一个小写字母。

prompt.en: What is the name of the marked angle?
prompt.zh: 标出的角叫什么？

guide.en: Find the vertex first. Its letter goes in the middle of the name.
guide.zh: 先找到顶点。顶点的字母写在名字中间。

hints.en: The two arms meet at Q.
hints.zh: 两条边在 Q 相交。

hints.en: Start at P, go through Q, end at R.
hints.zh: 从 P 出发，经过 Q，到 R。

correct.en: Yes. The arms meet at Q, so Q goes in the middle: ∠PQR.
correct.zh: 对。两条边在 Q 相交，Q 写在中间：∠PQR。

fallback.en: Not yet. Which letter is at the vertex? Put it in the middle.
fallback.zh: 还没对。顶点是哪个字母？把它写在中间。

reveal.en: The vertex is Q, so the angle is ∠PQR (or ∠RQP).
reveal.zh: 顶点是 Q，所以这个角是 ∠PQR（也可以写 ∠RQP）。

say.en: The vertex letter always goes in the middle: this angle turns at Q.
say.zh: 顶点的字母永远在中间：这个角的顶点是 Q。

prompt.en: What is the name of the marked angle?
prompt.zh: 标出的角叫什么？

guide.en: Find the point where the two arms meet. That letter goes in the middle.
guide.zh: 找到两条边相交的点。这个字母写在中间。

hints.en: The arms meet at Y.
hints.zh: 两条边在 Y 相交。

hints.en: Go from X, through Y, to Z.
hints.zh: 从 X 出发，经过 Y，到 Z。

correct.en: Yes. The vertex is Y, so it sits in the middle: ∠XYZ.
correct.zh: 对。顶点是 Y，写在中间：∠XYZ。

fallback.en: Not yet. Which letter is at the vertex?
fallback.zh: 还没对。顶点是哪个字母？

reveal.en: The vertex is Y: the angle is ∠XYZ, or ∠ZYX.
reveal.zh: 顶点是 Y：这个角是 ∠XYZ，也可以写 ∠ZYX。

say.en: The vertex letter always goes in the middle of the name. This angle turns at Y.
say.zh: 顶点的字母永远写在名字中间。这个角的顶点是 Y。

prompt.en: Three angles meet at Q. Which drawing marks ∠PQR?
prompt.zh: 三个角的顶点都是 Q。哪幅图标出的是 ∠PQR？

guide.en: ∠PQR starts on arm QP, turns at Q and ends on arm QR.
guide.zh: ∠PQR 从边 QP 出发，在 Q 处转，到边 QR 为止。

hints.en: Find the arms through P and through R.
hints.zh: 找出经过 P 和经过 R 的两条边。

hints.en: The angle between them is the widest of the three.
hints.zh: 它们之间的角是三个里最大的。

correct.en: Yes. The arc runs from arm QP all the way to arm QR.
correct.zh: 对。这段弧从边 QP 一直到边 QR。

fallback.en: Not yet. Read the name: P, then Q, then R. The arc must go from the arm through P to the arm through R.
fallback.zh: 还没对。按名字读：P、Q、R。弧要从经过 P 的边到经过 R 的边。

reveal.en: ∠PQR is the whole angle from QP to QR. The other two are ∠PQS and ∠SQR.
reveal.zh: ∠PQR 是从 QP 到 QR 的整个角。另外两个是 ∠PQS 和 ∠SQR。

prompt.en: Three angles meet at Q. What is the name of the marked one?
prompt.zh: 三个角的顶点都是 Q。标出的角叫什么？

guide.en: With three angles at Q, one letter is not enough. Use the letters on the two arms of the marked angle.
guide.zh: Q 处有三个角，只写一个字母说不清。用标出的角两条边上的字母。

hints.en: The marked angle lies between arm QS and arm QR.
hints.zh: 标出的角在边 QS 和边 QR 之间。

hints.en: Put Q in the middle of S and R.
hints.zh: 把 Q 写在 S 和 R 中间。

correct.en: Yes. The marked angle is between QS and QR, so it is ∠SQR.
correct.zh: 对。标出的角在 QS 和 QR 之间，所以是 ∠SQR。

fallback.en: Not yet. Which two arms hold the marked angle?
fallback.zh: 还没对。标出的角夹在哪两条边之间？

reveal.en: ∠SQR: from S, through the vertex Q, to R.
reveal.zh: ∠SQR：从 S 出发，经过顶点 Q，到 R。

say.en: The vertex letter always goes in the middle of the name. With three angles at Q, write three letters, Q in the middle: ∠SQR.
say.zh: 顶点的字母永远写在名字中间。Q 处有三个角，要写三个字母，Q 在中间：∠SQR。

prompt.en: Which names are for the marked angle? Choose all that are.
prompt.zh: 哪些名字说的是标出的角？都选上。

guide.en: A name starts on one arm, goes through the vertex and ends on the other arm. Either arm can come first.
guide.zh: 名字从一条边出发，经过顶点，到另一条边。哪条边先写都可以。

hints.en: The vertex is E.
hints.zh: 顶点是 E。

hints.en: Two names have E in the middle.
hints.zh: 有两个名字的 E 在中间。

correct.en: Yes. ∠DEF and ∠FED both have E in the middle: they name the same angle.
correct.zh: 对。∠DEF 和 ∠FED 的 E 都在中间，说的是同一个角。

fallback.en: Not yet. Keep the names with the vertex E in the middle.
fallback.zh: 还没对。留下顶点 E 在中间的名字。

reveal.en: ∠DEF and ∠FED: the same angle, read from either arm.
reveal.zh: ∠DEF 和 ∠FED：同一个角，从哪条边读起都行。

say.en: The vertex letter always goes in the middle of the name. ∠EDF turns at D, not at E.
say.zh: 顶点的字母永远写在名字中间。∠EDF 的顶点是 D，不是 E。

prompt.en: Which two names say the same angle as the one marked?
prompt.zh: 哪两个名字说的是标出的这个角？

guide.en: The vertex letter goes in the middle; the arm letters go either side, in any order.
guide.zh: 顶点字母在中间，两条边的字母写在两边，先写哪个都行。

hints.en: The arms meet at L.
hints.zh: 两条边在 L 相交。

correct.en: Yes. ∠KLM and ∠MLK both turn at L.
correct.zh: 对。∠KLM 和 ∠MLK 的顶点都是 L。

fallback.en: Not yet. Which names have L in the middle?
fallback.zh: 还没对。哪些名字的 L 在中间？

reveal.en: ∠KLM = ∠MLK: L is the vertex.

say.en: The vertex letter always goes in the middle of the name. ∠LKM would turn at K.
say.zh: 顶点的字母永远写在名字中间。∠LKM 的顶点会是 K。

prompt.en: Which names are for the marked angle? Choose all that are.
prompt.zh: 哪些名字说的是标出的角？都选上。

guide.en: Three angles meet at B. Find the two arms of the marked angle, then put B between their letters.
guide.zh: B 处有三个角。找到标出的角的两条边，再把 B 写在它们的字母中间。

hints.en: The marked angle is between BC and BD.
hints.zh: 标出的角在 BC 和 BD 之间。

hints.en: C and D go either side of B.
hints.zh: C 和 D 写在 B 的两边。

correct.en: Yes. The marked angle lies between BD and BC: ∠DBC, or ∠CBD.
correct.zh: 对。标出的角在 BD 和 BC 之间：∠DBC，也可以写 ∠CBD。

fallback.en: Not yet. Use the letters on the two arms of the marked angle, with B in the middle.
fallback.zh: 还没对。用标出的角两条边上的字母，B 写在中间。

reveal.en: ∠DBC = ∠CBD. ∠ABC is the bigger angle from BC to BA.
reveal.zh: ∠DBC = ∠CBD。∠ABC 是从 BC 到 BA 的大角。

say.en: The vertex letter always goes in the middle of the name. Three angles turn at B, so "∠B" alone does not say which one.
say.zh: 顶点的字母永远写在名字中间。B 处有三个角，只写“∠B”说不清是哪一个。

prompt.en: What is the name of the marked angle, from BC round to BA?
prompt.zh: 标出的角从 BC 转到 BA，它叫什么？

guide.en: The marked angle holds the arm BD inside it. Its own arms are BC and BA.
guide.zh: 标出的角里面还有一条边 BD。它自己的两条边是 BC 和 BA。

hints.en: The vertex is B.
hints.zh: 顶点是 B。

hints.en: Use C and A, the letters on its own arms.
hints.zh: 用它自己两条边上的字母 C 和 A。

correct.en: Yes. ∠CBA runs from arm BC to arm BA, turning at B.
correct.zh: 对。∠CBA 从边 BC 到边 BA，顶点是 B。

fallback.en: Not yet. Which two arms hold the marked angle?
fallback.zh: 还没对。标出的角夹在哪两条边之间？

reveal.en: ∠CBA (or ∠ABC). ∠DBA is only the top part.
reveal.zh: ∠CBA（也可以写 ∠ABC）。∠DBA 只是上面那一部分。

say.en: The vertex letter always goes in the middle of the name. ∠CAB would turn at A; this angle turns at B.
say.zh: 顶点的字母永远写在名字中间。∠CAB 的顶点会是 A；这个角的顶点是 B。

prompt.en: Which names are for the marked angle? Choose all that are.
prompt.zh: 哪些名字说的是标出的角？都选上。

guide.en: The marked angle is the top one of the three at B. Use the letters on its two arms, with B in the middle.
guide.zh: 标出的是 B 处三个角里最上面的那个。用它两条边上的字母，B 写在中间。

hints.en: Its arms are BD and BA.
hints.zh: 它的两条边是 BD 和 BA。

hints.en: Two names have B in the middle and use A and D.
hints.zh: 有两个名字 B 在中间，用的是 A 和 D。

correct.en: Yes. The marked angle lies between BA and BD: ∠ABD, or ∠DBA.
correct.zh: 对。标出的角在 BA 和 BD 之间：∠ABD，也可以写 ∠DBA。

fallback.en: Not yet. Which two arms hold the marked angle? Put B between their letters.
fallback.zh: 还没对。标出的角夹在哪两条边之间？把 B 写在它们的字母中间。

reveal.en: ∠ABD = ∠DBA. ∠ABC is the whole angle from BC to BA.
reveal.zh: ∠ABD = ∠DBA。∠ABC 是从 BC 到 BA 的整个角。

say.en: The vertex letter always goes in the middle: ∠BAD would turn at A, not at B.
say.zh: 顶点的字母永远在中间：∠BAD 的顶点会是 A，不是 B。

caption.en: Angles are measured in degrees. A full turn is 360 degrees, written 360°. A right angle is a quarter turn: 90°.
caption.zh: 角的大小用“度”来量。一整圈是 360 度，写作 360°。直角是四分之一圈：90°。

words.en: centre on the vertex · 0 on an arm
words.zh: 中心对顶点 · 0 线对一条边

caption.en: Put the centre of the protractor on the vertex. Turn it so that the 0 line lies along one arm.
caption.zh: 把量角器的中心对准顶点，转一转，让 0 线和一条边对齐。

caption.en: There are two rows of numbers. Use the row that starts at 0 on the arm you lined up, and count up to the other arm: 50°.
caption.zh: 量角器上有两圈数。用 0 对着你对齐那条边的那一圈，一直数到另一条边：50°。

caption.en: The other row says 130 here. Check with a right angle: this angle is smaller, so it must be less than 90°. It is 50°.
caption.zh: 另一圈这里写着 130。和直角比一比：这个角比直角小，一定小于 90°。它是 50°。

caption.en: When the arm you line up points left, its 0 is on the other row. Count from that 0: the angle is 65°.
caption.zh: 对齐的那条边朝左时，它的 0 在另一圈上。从那个 0 数起：这个角是 65°。

keyFacts.en: Centre on the vertex, 0 on an arm, count from 0.
keyFacts.zh: 中心对顶点，0 线对一条边，从 0 数起。

keyFacts.en: Check with a right angle: smaller means less than 90°.
keyFacts.zh: 和直角比：比直角小，就小于 90°。

prompt.en: Lay the protractor on the angle, then write its size.
prompt.zh: 把量角器摆到角上，再写出它的度数。

guide.en: Centre on the vertex, 0 on an arm, count from 0. Then check with a right angle.
guide.zh: 中心对顶点，0 线对一条边，从 0 数起。再和直角比一比。

hints.en: Drag the protractor so its centre is on the vertex, or use the buttons.
hints.zh: 把量角器拖到中心对准顶点，也可以用按钮。

hints.en: Use the row whose 0 is on the arm you lined up.
hints.zh: 用 0 对着你对齐那条边的那一圈。

hints.en: The angle is smaller than a right angle, so it is less than 90°.
hints.zh: 这个角比直角小，所以小于 90°。

correct.en: Yes. Counting from 0 on the lined-up arm, the other arm is at 50: 50°.
correct.zh: 对。从对齐那条边的 0 数起，另一条边指着 50：50°。

fallback.en: Not yet. Start from the 0 that is on an arm and count up to the other arm.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从对着边的那个 0 开始，数到另一条边。

reveal.en: The angle is 50°: smaller than a right angle.

say.en: Which row starts at 0 on the arm you lined up? Count up from that 0. Check: this angle is smaller than a right angle, so it is less than 90°.
say.zh: 哪一圈的 0 对着你对齐的那条边？从那个 0 数起。再和直角比一比：这个角比直角小，一定小于 90°。

prompt.en: Lay the protractor on the angle, then write its size.
prompt.zh: 把量角器摆到角上，再写出它的度数。

guide.en: Centre on the vertex, 0 on an arm, count from 0. It opens to the left, so the arm you line up may have its 0 on the outer row.
guide.zh: 中心对顶点，0 线对一条边，从 0 数起。它朝左张开，对齐的那条边的 0 可能在外圈。

hints.en: Use the buttons, or drag the protractor onto the vertex and turn it onto an arm.
hints.zh: 用按钮，或者把量角器拖到顶点上，再转到对齐一条边。

hints.en: Read the row whose 0 lies on the arm you lined up.
hints.zh: 读 0 对着你对齐那条边的那一圈。

hints.en: The angle is greater than a right angle.
hints.zh: 这个角比直角大。

correct.en: Yes. Counting from 0 on the lined-up arm, the other arm is at 125: 125°.
correct.zh: 对。从对齐那条边的 0 数起，另一条边指着 125：125°。

fallback.en: Not yet. Start from the 0 that is on an arm and count up to the other arm.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从对着边的那个 0 开始，数到另一条边。

reveal.en: The angle is 125°: greater than a right angle.

say.en: Which row starts at 0 on the arm you lined up? Count up from that 0. Check: this angle is greater than a right angle, so it is more than 90°.
say.zh: 哪一圈的 0 对着你对齐的那条边？从那个 0 数起。再和直角比一比：这个角比直角大，一定大于 90°。

prompt.en: Lay the protractor on the angle, then write its size.
prompt.zh: 把量角器摆到角上，再写出它的度数。

guide.en: Centre on the vertex, 0 on an arm, count from 0. Line the 0 up with one arm and count to the other.
guide.zh: 中心对顶点，0 线对一条边，从 0 数起。让 0 线对齐一条边，再数到另一条边。

hints.en: Use the buttons, or drag the protractor onto the vertex and turn it onto an arm.
hints.zh: 用按钮，或者把量角器拖到顶点上，再转到对齐一条边。

hints.en: Read the row whose 0 lies on the arm you lined up.
hints.zh: 读 0 对着你对齐那条边的那一圈。

hints.en: The angle is smaller than a right angle.
hints.zh: 这个角比直角小。

correct.en: Yes. Counting from 0 on the lined-up arm, the other arm is at 35: 35°.
correct.zh: 对。从对齐那条边的 0 数起，另一条边指着 35：35°。

fallback.en: Not yet. Start from the 0 that is on an arm and count up to the other arm.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从对着边的那个 0 开始，数到另一条边。

reveal.en: The angle is 35°: smaller than a right angle.

say.en: Which row starts at 0 on the arm you lined up? Count up from that 0. Check: this angle is smaller than a right angle, so it is less than 90°.
say.zh: 哪一圈的 0 对着你对齐的那条边？从那个 0 数起。再和直角比一比：这个角比直角小，一定小于 90°。

correct.en: Yes. Counting from 0 on the lined-up arm, the other arm is at 40: 40°.
correct.zh: 对。从对齐那条边的 0 数起，另一条边指着 40：40°。

fallback.en: Not yet. Start from the 0 that is on an arm and count up to the other arm.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从对着边的那个 0 开始，数到另一条边。

reveal.en: The angle is 40°: smaller than a right angle.

prompt.zh: 把量角器摆到角上，再写出它的度数。

guide.zh: 中心对顶点，0 线对一条边，从 0 数起。让 0 线对齐一条边，再数到另一条边。

hints.zh: 用按钮，或者把量角器拖到顶点上，再转到对齐一条边。

hints.en: The angle is greater than a right angle.
hints.zh: 这个角比直角大。

correct.en: Yes. Counting from 0 on the lined-up arm, the other arm is at 150: 150°.
correct.zh: 对。从对齐那条边的 0 数起，另一条边指着 150：150°。

fallback.en: Not yet. Start from the 0 that is on an arm and count up to the other arm.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从对着边的那个 0 开始，数到另一条边。

reveal.en: The angle is 150°: greater than a right angle.

prompt.en: The protractor is in place. Read the size of ∠PQR.
prompt.zh: 量角器已经摆好了。读出 ∠PQR 的度数。

guide.en: Arm QP lies on a 0. Use the row that starts there.
guide.zh: 边 QP 对着一个 0。用从这里开始的那一圈。

hints.en: QP points right: its 0 is on the inner row.
hints.zh: QP 朝右，它的 0 在内圈。

hints.en: The angle is smaller than a right angle.
hints.zh: 这个角比直角小。

correct.en: Yes. From the 0 on QP, the other arm is at 70: 70°.
correct.zh: 对。从 QP 上的 0 数起，另一条边指着 70：70°。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the 0 on an arm, or count the steps between the two arms.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找到对着边的 0，或者数一数两条边之间隔了多少。

reveal.en: ∠PQR = 70°, smaller than a right angle.

say.en: Which row starts at 0 on QP? Count up from that 0. This angle is smaller than a right angle, so it is less than 90°.
say.zh: 哪一圈的 0 对着 QP？从那个 0 数起。这个角比直角小，一定小于 90°。

prompt.en: The protractor is not lined up with an arm. Find the size of ∠PQR.
prompt.zh: 量角器没有对齐一条边。求 ∠PQR 的度数。

guide.en: Arm QP is on 20, not on 0. Count from 20 to the other arm, like reading a ruler that does not start at 0.
guide.zh: 边 QP 对着 20，不是 0。从 20 数到另一条边，就像读一把不从 0 量起的尺。

hints.en: QP is on 20 and QR is on 75 on the inner row.
hints.zh: 在内圈上，QP 对着 20，QR 对着 75。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the 0 on an arm, or count the steps between the two arms.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找到对着边的 0，或者数一数两条边之间隔了多少。

reveal.en: QP is on 20 and QR on 75: 75 − 20 = 55°.

say.en: This arm is on 20, not on 0. Count from 20 to 75: 75 − 20 = 55°.
That is a number on the outer row. Stay on the row where QP is on 20, and count from 20.
say.zh: 这是外圈上的数。就在 QP 对着 20 的那一圈上，从 20 数起。

prompt.en: The protractor is in place. Read the size of ∠PQR.
prompt.zh: 量角器已经摆好了。读出 ∠PQR 的度数。

guide.en: Arm QP points left, so its 0 is on the outer row. Count up from that 0.
guide.zh: 边 QP 朝左，它的 0 在外圈。从这个 0 数起。

hints.en: Start at the 0 on the left, on the outer row.
hints.zh: 从左边外圈的 0 开始。

hints.en: The angle is smaller than a right angle.
hints.zh: 这个角比直角小。

correct.en: Yes. Counting from 0 on the outer row, QR is at 48: 48°.
correct.zh: 对。从外圈的 0 数起，QR 指着 48：48°。

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the 0 on an arm, or count the steps between the two arms.
fallback.zh: 还没对。找到对着边的 0，或者数一数两条边之间隔了多少。

say.en: Opposite angles face each other across the crossing and are equal. An angle next to another makes a straight line with it: together 180°.

correct.en: Yes. The opposite angle is 35°, so ∠x = 180° − 35° − 90° = 55°.

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the angle opposite 35° first, then use the straight line.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先找 35° 的对顶角，再用直线上的角。

reveal.en: ∠x = 180° − 35° − 90° = 55° (vertically opposite angles, angles on a straight line).

say.en: The small square means a right angle: 90°, even though no number is written.
say.zh: 这个小方块表示直角，是 90°，虽然没写数字。

say.en: The drawing is not to scale, so measuring it does not work. Use the facts.
say.zh: 图没有按比例画，量出来的不算数。用规律算。

prompt.en: Find ∠x.
prompt.zh: 求 ∠x。

guide.en: Look for the straight line. The drawing is not to scale.
guide.zh: 找出那条直线。图没有按比例画。

hints.en: The two angles make a straight line.
hints.zh: 这两个角拼成一条直线。

correct.en: Yes. ∠x = 180° − 118° = 62° (angles on a straight line).

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the line, the point or the crossing the angle sits on, then use its fact.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先看这个角在直线上、一点周围，还是在交叉处，再用对应的规律。

reveal.en: ∠x = 180° − 118° = 62° (angles on a straight line).

say.en: These angles sit on a straight line: half a turn, 180°. A full turn, 360°, is for angles all the way round a point.
say.zh: 这几个角在一条直线上，是半圈，180°。整整一圈 360° 是一点周围的角。

say.en: The drawing is not to scale, so measuring it does not work. Work it out from the numbers given.
say.zh: 图没有按比例画，量出来的不算数。要用标出的数来算。

prompt.en: Find ∠y.
prompt.zh: 求 ∠y。

guide.en: The angles go round a point; one is a right angle.
guide.zh: 这些角绕着一点，其中一个是直角。

hints.en: Angles at a point make 360°; the square is 90°.
hints.zh: 一点周围是 360°，小方块是 90°。

correct.en: Yes. ∠y = 360° − 90° − 125° = 145° (angles at a point).

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the line, the point or the crossing the angle sits on, then use its fact.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先看这个角在直线上、一点周围，还是在交叉处，再用对应的规律。

say.en: The small square means a right angle: 90°, even though no number is written.
say.zh: 这个小方块表示直角，是 90°，虽然没写数字。

say.en: The drawing is not to scale, so measuring it does not work. Work it out from the numbers given.
say.zh: 图没有按比例画，量出来的不算数。要用标出的数来算。

prompt.en: Find ∠z.
prompt.zh: 求 ∠z。

guide.en: Two steps: the angle opposite 38°, then the straight line.
guide.zh: 两步：先找 38° 的对顶角，再用直线。

hints.en: The angle opposite 38° is also 38°, next to ∠z on the line.
hints.zh: 38° 的对顶角也是 38°，在直线上挨着 ∠z。

correct.en: Yes. ∠z = 180° − 38° − 70° = 72° (vertically opposite angles, angles on a straight line).

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the line, the point or the crossing the angle sits on, then use its fact.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先看这个角在直线上、一点周围，还是在交叉处，再用对应的规律。

reveal.en: ∠z = 180° − 38° − 70° = 72° (vertically opposite angles, angles on a straight line).

say.en: These angles sit on a straight line: half a turn, 180°. A full turn, 360°, is for angles all the way round a point.
say.zh: 这几个角在一条直线上，是半圈，180°。整整一圈 360° 是一点周围的角。

say.en: The drawing is not to scale, so measuring it does not work. Work it out from the numbers given.
say.zh: 图没有按比例画，量出来的不算数。要用标出的数来算。

prompt.en: Find ∠q. The two angles marked q are equal.
prompt.zh: 求 ∠q。两个标 q 的角相等。

guide.en: Find what the two equal angles make together, then halve it.
guide.zh: 先求两个相等的角合起来是多少，再除以 2。

hints.en: 360° − 130° = 230° for the two together.

correct.en: Yes. ∠q = (360° − 130°) ÷ 2 = 115° (angles at a point).

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the line, the point or the crossing the angle sits on, then use its fact.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先看这个角在直线上、一点周围，还是在交叉处，再用对应的规律。

say.en: These angles go all the way round the point: a full turn, 360°. 180° is only for angles on a straight line.
say.zh: 这些角绕着这一点一整圈，是 360°。180° 只用于直线上的角。

say.en: The drawing is not to scale, so measuring it does not work. Work it out from the numbers given.
say.zh: 图没有按比例画，量出来的不算数。要用标出的数来算。

prompt.en: Find ∠b.
prompt.zh: 求 ∠b。

guide.en: ∠b is next to 58° at the crossing, not opposite it.
guide.zh: ∠b 在交叉处挨着 58°，不是在它对面。

hints.en: ∠b and 58° make a straight line.
hints.zh: ∠b 和 58° 拼成一条直线。

correct.en: Yes. ∠b = 180° − 58° = 122° (angles on a straight line).

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the line, the point or the crossing the angle sits on, then use its fact.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先看这个角在直线上、一点周围，还是在交叉处，再用对应的规律。

reveal.en: ∠b = 180° − 58° = 122° (angles on a straight line).

say.en: Opposite angles face each other across the crossing and are equal. An angle next to another makes a straight line with it: together 180°.
say.zh: 对顶角隔着交点面对面，它们相等。挨着的两个角拼成一条直线，合起来是 180°。

say.en: The drawing is not to scale, so measuring it does not work. Work it out from the numbers given.
say.zh: 图没有按比例画，量出来的不算数。要用标出的数来算。

prompt.en: Find ∠w.
prompt.zh: 求 ∠w。

guide.en: The angles sit on one straight line, so together they make 180°.
guide.zh: 这些角在一条直线上，合起来是 180°。

correct.en: Yes. ∠w = 180° − 27° − 68° = 85° (angles on a straight line).

fallback.en: Not yet. Find the line, the point or the crossing the angle sits on, then use its fact.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先看这个角在直线上、一点周围，还是在交叉处，再用对应的规律。

reveal.en: ∠w = 180° − 27° − 68° = 85° (angles on a straight line).

say.en: These angles sit on a straight line: half a turn, 180°. A full turn, 360°, is for angles all the way round a point.
say.zh: 这几个角在一条直线上，是半圈，180°。整整一圈 360° 是一点周围的角。

say.en: The drawing is not to scale, so measuring it does not work. Work it out from the numbers given.
say.zh: 图没有按比例画，量出来的不算数。要用标出的数来算。

text.en: Angles on a straight line add up to 180°.
Angles at a point add up to 360°.
text.zh: 一点周围的角加起来是 360°。

prompt.en: Which fact finds ∠y in one step?
prompt.zh: 用哪条规律一步就能求出 ∠y？

guide.en: Look at where ∠y sits compared with 44°.
guide.zh: 看 ∠y 和 44° 的位置关系。

hints.en: ∠y faces 44° across the crossing.
hints.zh: ∠y 隔着交点和 44° 面对面。

correct.en: Yes. ∠y faces 44° across the crossing, so ∠y = 44°.
correct.zh: 对。∠y 隔着交点和 44° 面对面，所以 ∠y = 44°。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at how the angles sit: on a straight line, round a point, or across a crossing.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看这些角是怎么放的：在一条直线上、绕着一点，还是隔着交点。

reveal.en: ∠y and 44° are vertically opposite angles, so ∠y = 44°.

say.en: ∠y does not sit next to 44° on a line; it faces it across the crossing. Opposite angles are equal.
say.zh: ∠y 没有和 44° 挨着拼成直线，而是隔着交点和它面对面。对顶角相等。

text.en: Angles on a straight line add up to 180°.
Angles at a point add up to 360°.
text.zh: 一点周围的角加起来是 360°。

prompt.en: Which fact finds ∠z?
prompt.zh: 用哪条规律能求出 ∠z？

guide.en: Look at what ∠z and 125° sit on.
guide.zh: 看 ∠z 和 125° 在什么上。

hints.en: The two angles share one straight line.
hints.zh: 这两个角在同一条直线上。

correct.en: Yes. ∠z and 125° sit on a straight line: ∠z = 180° − 125° = 55°.

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at how the angles sit: on a straight line, round a point, or across a crossing.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看这些角是怎么放的：在一条直线上、绕着一点，还是隔着交点。

reveal.en: Angles on a straight line: ∠z = 180° − 125° = 55°.

say.en: These angles sit on a straight line: half a turn, 180°. A full turn, 360°, is for angles all the way round a point.
say.zh: 这几个角在一条直线上，是半圈，180°。整整一圈 360° 是一点周围的角。

prompt.en: Which number sentence finds ∠w?
prompt.zh: 哪个算式能求出 ∠w？

guide.en: The angles go round a point. Count the right angle too.
guide.zh: 这些角绕着一点。直角也要算上。

hints.en: Angles at a point make 360°.
hints.zh: 一点周围的角是 360°。

hints.en: Take away 90° and 110°.

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at how the angles sit: on a straight line, round a point, or across a crossing.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看这些角是怎么放的：在一条直线上、绕着一点，还是隔着交点。

say.en: The small square means a right angle: 90°, even though no number is written.
say.zh: 这个小方块表示直角，是 90°，虽然没写数字。

say.en: These angles go all the way round the point: a full turn, 360°. 180° is only for angles on a straight line.
say.zh: 这些角绕着这一点一整圈，是 360°。180° 只用于直线上的角。

prompt.en: Which angle is bigger?
prompt.zh: 哪个角大？

guide.en: Compare how far the arms have turned apart, not how long they are.
guide.zh: 比一比两条边张开了多少，不看边有多长。

hints.en: Picture one angle laid on the other, vertex on vertex.
hints.zh: 想象把一个角叠到另一个上，顶点对顶点。

correct.en: Yes. B has turned more, so it is bigger, even though its arms are short.
correct.zh: 对。B 转得多，所以角大，虽然它的边短。

fallback.en: Not yet. Compare the turn, not the arms.
fallback.zh: 还没对。比转了多少，不比边。

reveal.en: B is bigger: its arms are opened wider.
reveal.zh: B 大：它的两条边张得更开。

say.en: These arms are longer, but they have turned less. Compare the turn, not the length of the arms.
say.zh: 这两条边长，可是转得少。比的是转了多少，不是边有多长。

prompt.en: Which of these are right angles? Choose all that are.
prompt.zh: 哪些是直角？把是直角的都选上。

guide.en: A right angle is a square corner, however it is turned.
guide.zh: 直角是方方正正的角，不管怎么放。

hints.en: Two are square corners, and one of them is tilted.
hints.zh: 有两个是方方正正的角，其中一个斜着放。

correct.en: Yes. A and B are right angles; A is just turned.
correct.zh: 对。A 和 B 是直角，A 只是斜着放。

fallback.en: Not yet. Put a tester in each corner in your head.
fallback.zh: 还没对。在脑子里把直角板放进每个角。

reveal.en: A and B are right angles. C is a little smaller and D a little greater.
reveal.zh: A 和 B 是直角。C 比直角小一点，D 比直角大一点。

say.en: Turn the page in your head: the tilted corner is still square. Put the right-angle tester in it.
say.zh: 在脑子里把纸转一转，斜着的这个角还是方方正正的。用直角板去比一比。

prompt.en: Draw a line from P parallel to AB. Tap the dot where it ends.
prompt.zh: 从 P 画一条和 AB 平行的线。点一下线的另一端。

guide.en: Copy the steps of AB: how many dots right, how many up.
guide.zh: 照着 AB 的走法：向右几格、向上几格。

hints.en: AB goes 3 right and 1 up.
hints.zh: AB 向右 3 格、向上 1 格。

correct.en: Yes. Your line goes 3 right and 1 up, like AB.
correct.zh: 对。你的线向右 3 格、向上 1 格，和 AB 一样。

fallback.en: Not yet. Copy the steps of AB from P.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从 P 照着 AB 的走法画。

reveal.en: From P go 3 right and 1 up.
reveal.zh: 从 P 向右 3 格、向上 1 格。

say.en: These lines come closer as they go: yours goes up 2, AB only 1. Parallel lines stay the same distance apart.
say.zh: 这两条线越走越近：你的线向上 2 格，AB 只向上 1 格。平行线之间的距离处处一样。

prompt.en: Lay the protractor on ∠PQR, then write its size.
prompt.zh: 把量角器摆到 ∠PQR 上，再写出它的度数。

guide.en: Centre on Q, 0 on an arm, count from 0. Then check with a right angle.
guide.zh: 中心对准 Q，0 线对一条边，从 0 数起。再和直角比一比。

hints.en: QP points left: its 0 is on the outer row.
hints.zh: QP 朝左：它的 0 在外圈上。

correct.en: Yes. From 0 on QP the other arm is at 48: 48°.
correct.zh: 对。从 QP 上的 0 数起，另一条边指着 48：48°。

fallback.en: Not yet. Start from the 0 that lies on an arm.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从对着边的那个 0 数起。

reveal.en: ∠PQR = 48°: smaller than a right angle.

say.en: Which row starts at 0 on the arm you lined up? Count up from that 0. This angle is smaller than a right angle, so it is less than 90°.
say.zh: 哪一圈的 0 对着你对齐的那条边？从那个 0 数起。这个角比直角小，一定小于 90°。

prompt.en: Turn the second arm to draw ∠XYZ = 125°.
prompt.zh: 转动第二条边，画出 ∠XYZ = 125°。

guide.en: Use the row whose 0 is on YZ and stop at 125.
guide.zh: 用 0 对着 YZ 的那一圈，转到 125 停下。

hints.en: 125° is greater than a right angle.
hints.zh: 125° 比直角大。

correct.en: Yes. The arm points at 125 on the row from YZ: greater than a right angle.
correct.zh: 对。这条边指着从 YZ 数起那一圈的 125，比直角大。

fallback.en: Not yet. Count from the 0 on YZ to 125.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从 YZ 上的 0 数到 125。

reveal.en: ∠XYZ = 125°: the arm at 125 on the inner row.

say.en: You drew 55°, on the other row. A 125° angle is greater than a right angle.
say.zh: 你画成了 55°，用的是另一圈。125° 的角比直角大。

prompt.en: Find ∠a.
prompt.zh: 求 ∠a。

guide.en: The three angles sit on a straight line.
guide.zh: 这三个角在一条直线上。

fallback.en: Not yet. Angles on a straight line add up to 180°.
fallback.zh: 还没对。直线上的角加起来是 180°。

say.en: These angles sit on a straight line: half a turn, 180°, not 360°.
say.zh: 这几个角在一条直线上，是半圈，180°，不是 360°。

prompt.en: Find ∠b.
prompt.zh: 求 ∠b。

guide.en: ∠b faces the 63° angle across the crossing.
guide.zh: ∠b 隔着交点和 63° 面对面。

hints.en: Vertically opposite angles are equal.
hints.zh: 对顶角相等。

correct.en: Yes. ∠b and 63° are vertically opposite: ∠b = 63°.
correct.zh: 对。∠b 和 63° 是对顶角：∠b = 63°。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the angle facing ∠b.
fallback.zh: 还没对。看和 ∠b 面对面的那个角。

reveal.en: ∠b = 63° (vertically opposite angles).

say.en: Opposite angles face each other across the crossing; they are equal. 117° is the angle next to 63°.
say.zh: 对顶角隔着交点面对面，它们相等。117° 是挨着 63° 的那个角。

prompt.en: Find ∠c.
prompt.zh: 求 ∠c。

guide.en: The angles go all the way round the point; one is marked with a small square.
guide.zh: 这些角绕这一点一整圈，其中一个标着小方块。

fallback.en: Not yet. Take everything you know, the right angle too, from 360°.
fallback.zh: 还没对。从 360° 里减去所有已知的角，别忘了直角。

say.en: The small square means a right angle: 90°, even though no number is written.
say.zh: 这个小方块表示直角，是 90°，虽然没写数字。

say.en: The drawing is not to scale, so measuring it does not work. Use the facts: angles at a point add up to 360°.
say.zh: 图没有按比例画，量出来的不算数。用规律算：一点周围的角加起来是 360°。
